messages: anya: Quick follow-up on the playground streaming UX. Trying a compact approach: token badge inside the composer (small badge that expands on hover), an overlay for preserved partials (so composer stays predictable), and a single control set: Pause / Stop / Regenerate. Linking prototype: https://figma.com/redwood/compact-playground ben: Short notes: overlay feels cleaner than auto-insert. For microcopy I like: Pause (||), Stop (save draft), Regenerate (run new). Keep mobile labels <= 6 chars. Token badge: live count while streaming, then collapse to a dot with tooltip. On regen show a transient "+N" toast near badge. maria: Product rules: Stop saves a client-only draft in overlay; user must Apply to move into composer. Regenerate always produces a new generation entry. No silent overwrites. Also add an ellipsis menu on drafts: Apply / Revert / Delete. sam: Engineering constraints: Stop = server cancel + emit final tokens_consumed event (aborted=true if early). Pause = client stop reading but server may still be generating; we'll avoid long-held allocations. We'll add generation.status tags: streaming, paused, stopped_partial, completed. Token badge needs final delta event. linda: Accessibility: overlay must trap focus and be announced via aria-live: "Partial response available as draft." Token badge should be focusable and use role=status. Keyboard: Tab order to controls -> composer -> token badge -> prompt shelf shortcut (Ctrl+Space). Example snippet: ``` Tokens: 73 ``` linda: Also ensure the +N delta is read: "Generation used 42 tokens." ben: QA question: if user edits preserved draft then regenerates, regenerate should run on visible draft. Confirm? maria: Confirmed. We'll document and add a small inline note: "Running regenerate on edited draft." Also add revert to original partial in the menu. sam: I'll spike the token delta event and the generation.status flags. Might need a short-lived client flag for Pause handling to avoid billing surprises. anya: Action items: ben update frames with overlay + compact badge (ETA today), sam spike backend flags (2d), maria write flow doc + menu affordances (1d), linda produce a11y checklist and test cases (2d). I'll book 20m follow-up Wed 11am PT. dev-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming compact review" Wed 11:00 PT. React with :+1: to join. anya: thanks all, keeping thread open for quick comments.
